description: This file implements the ControlClientServerInternal class, which manages IPC communication for control events such as application state changes and pings within the Rialto server component. It includes functions to convert application states, send events via an IPC client, and encapsulates control-related IPC logic.

classes.name: ControlClientServerInternal
classes.description: A class responsible for managing IPC communication for control events such as application state changes and pings within the Rialto server.

methods.name: ControlClientServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing the control ID and IPC client reference.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Sends an application state change event via IPC.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping event with a specified ID via IPC.
